I'll think this through like I always do — start from what I did last year and decide what to change.

My land is 10.1 mu, wheat in winter and maize in summer, same as always in Quzhou. My wife works in the county town half the year, so for the busy times I mostly manage alone or hire a neighbor's machine for an afternoon. Money is tight but not desperate.

**Wheat (winter):**
Last October I planted Jimai variety — the dealer at the township shop sold me that one, my neighbor Old Wang got over 500 jin per mu with it so I trust it. I'll plant it again this year, 40 jin seed per mu.

Fertilizer — I use compound fertilizer 15-15-15, about 50 jin (25 kg) per mu as base fertilizer before planting. Then at jointing in spring I topdress urea, maybe 30 jin (15 kg) per mu. So total N is roughly 22 kg/mu. I know some extension people say this is too much, but one year I cut back and the wheat looked yellow, I was scared so I went back to my old amount. Better to waste a bag of urea than lose 100 jin of grain.

Irrigation from my well — winter water before freezing, then returning-green water in spring, then at grain filling. Three times. If May is dry I add one more.

Spray — once for weeds in spring, once for aphids and powdery mildew at heading. Two sprays.

Tillage — I rent a rotary tiller from the village service, 40 yuan per mu. Everyone does rotary now, nobody ploughs deep anymore.

Expected yield — if weather is normal, 480 kg per mu. Good year maybe 520.

**Maize (summer):**
After wheat harvest in June I direct-seed maize, no tillage — just run the seeder through the stubble. Zhengdan 958 or whatever hybrid the dealer pushes that year, they are all similar. 4 jin seed per mu.

Fertilizer — I side-dress compound fertilizer at planting, about 40 jin (20 kg) per mu, then urea at big-trumpet stage, 25 jin (12 kg) per mu. Total N around 18 kg/mu. Maize in summer grows fast with the rain, doesn't need as much as wheat.

Irrigation — depends on rain. Usually I water once at seedling if June is dry, once at tasseling. Two times on average.

Spray — once for armyworm if I see them, once herbicide after planting. Two sprays.

Expected yield — 550 kg per mu, summer maize is reliable here.
